nodes.rationale: Identifies and removes expired, unbound certificates in LocalMachine\My and WebHosting while protecting active IIS and HTTP.sys bindings.

nodes.label: Remove-ExpiredIISCertificate Specification & Status Codes
nodes.rationale: Defines input parameters (-List, -Execute, -WhatIf, -PassThru), 10 certificate status codes, UTF-8 BOM CSV schema, and TOCTOU re-verification.

nodes.label: PSJobScheduler Cron-Safe Job Scheduler Overview
nodes.rationale: Uses filename-encoded Cron-Safe syntax (X, @, L) and options (TIMEOUT, CB, NOW, LOG, CONCURRENT) so jobs can be versioned in Git without Task Scheduler XML.

nodes.label: PSJobScheduler Architecture & State Specification
nodes.rationale: Specifies ConvertFrom-JobFileName parser contract, SHA256 JobKey state/lock/completion JSON files, Repair-StaleLock PID reuse guard, and Event IDs 3001-3301.

nodes.label: Remove-ExpiredIISCertificate Agent Constraints
nodes.rationale: Must preserve PowerShell 5.1 and 7+ compatibility, never weaken Get-ProtectedThumbprints or CCS stop checks, and default logs to .\Logs.

nodes.label: IIS Certificate Binding Protection & Non-Goals
nodes.rationale: Prevents accidental deletion of bound certificates even if expired (reports EXPIRED_BOUND), avoids private key file destruction, and halts on Centralized Certificate Store (CCS).

nodes.label: PSJobScheduler Agent Constraints
nodes.rationale: Prohibits company-specific prefixes, preserves bundled nssm.exe and 6 sample jobs, and protects PID StartTime stale-lock verification and graceful shutdown.

nodes.label: PSJobScheduler Intent & Graceful Shutdown Principle
nodes.rationale: Avoids external DBMS dependencies and enforces graceful shutdown via schedule.stop so running batch jobs are not abruptly killed.
